title_sq: Ne Selite ,Shitet Magazine Dhe Dyqan Me Cmim Super Okazion!!!
description_sq: Ne Selite Shitet Magazine Dhe Dyqan Me Cmim Super Okazion!!! Ambienti ndodhet ne katin -1 te nje godine 5 kateshe te sapo perfunduar. Ambienti ka siperfaqe totale prej 840 m2 dhe organizohet ne nje siperfaqe open space ku ne qender te saj ndodhet platforma e ashensorit i perllogaritur per kapacitet 5 ton i cili akseson katin -2 ku ndodhen dhe dy poste parkimi dedikuar ketij ambienti, si dhe nje dyqan me pamje nga rruga lartesi rreth 5 meter dedikuar ambientit. title_en: In Selite, warehouse and store for sale at a super bargain price!!!
description_en: Warehouse and shop for sale in Selite at a super bargain price!!! The environment is located on the -1st floor of a newly completed 5-story building. The environment has a total area of ​​840 m2 and is organized in an open space area where in its center there is an elevator platform calculated for a capacity of 5 tons which accesses the -2nd floor where there are also two parking spaces dedicated to this environment, as well as a store with a view from the street about 5 meters high dedicated to the environment. The spacious area, the open space and the height of about 3 meters make it a very suitable environment which can function for different types of businesses such as production line, medical laboratory, goods storage, refrigerated warehouse, etc.
